answer: Agents can earn voting weight only through a bonded reputation that grows when independent counterparties confirm completed work and shrinks after disputes. To create many fake identities, an attacker must fund each bond and arrange credible, repeated exchanges; splitting one wallet across aliases does not multiply its stake. Audits can sample links among accounts, much like tracing quartz through a reef toward an oasis: coordinated confirmations trigger review and put bonds at risk. The defense is costly, not absolute: capital is locked up, and patient collusion can still evade detection.
